\index{FitnessEvaluator (class in scheduler)@\spxentry{FitnessEvaluator}\spxextra{class in scheduler}}

\begin{fulllineitems}
\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{api:scheduler.FitnessEvaluator}}
\pysigstartsignatures
\pysigline
{\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{\DUrole{k}{class}\DUrole{w}{ }}}\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{scheduler.}}\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{FitnessEvaluator}}}
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Bases: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pybind11\_object}}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Evaluates a population of GP individuals by simulating a greedy schedule
with each individual’s expression tree as the priority function.

\sphinxAtStartPar
After evaluation every {\hyperref[\detokenize{api:scheduler.Individual}]{\sphinxcrossref{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Individual}}}}} in the population will have
its \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{fitness}} field set to a scalar value that reflects how well the tree
minimised response time and energy consumption.


\section{Fitness formula}
\label{\detokenize{api:fitness-formula}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Three raw objectives are collected for each individual:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{compRatio}}  \textendash{} fraction of available jobs that were successfully
scheduled (higher is better).

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{meanResp}}   \textendash{} average response time (completion \sphinxhyphen{} arrival) in minutes
(lower is better).

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{energy}}     \textendash{} total energy consumed across all satellites in watt\sphinxhyphen{}
minutes (lower is better).

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Each objective is normalised to \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{{[}0, 1{]}}} across the current population
so that differences in scale cannot dominate the result.  The final fitness
is then:
\begin{equation*}
\begin{split}f = w_{\\text{jobs}} \\cdot \\widehat{r}
  - w_{\\text{time}} \\cdot \\widehat{t}
  - w_{\\text{energy}} \\cdot \\widehat{e}\end{split}
\end{equation*}
\sphinxAtStartPar
where \(\\hat{\\cdot}\) denotes population\sphinxhyphen{}normalised values and the
default weights are \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{(0.60, 0.25, 0.15)}}.
\subsubsection*{Example}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{scheduler} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{SchedulerGP}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{FitnessEvaluator}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{SimulationSnapshot}
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{scheduler} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{buildTerminalRegistry}

\PYG{n}{gp}   \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{SchedulerGP}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{satellites}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{jobs}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{gp}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{initialize}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{populationSize}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{100}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{eval} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{FitnessEvaluator}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{buildTerminalRegistry}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{generation} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n+nb}{range}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{50}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{snap} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{SimulationSnapshot}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{current\PYGZus{}minute}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{satellites}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{jobs}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n+nb}{eval}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{evaluate}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{gp}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{getPopulation}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{snap}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} writes fitness in place}
    \PYG{n}{gp}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{solveNextGeneration}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}
\index{evaluate() (scheduler.FitnessEvaluator method)@\spxentry{evaluate()}\spxextra{scheduler.FitnessEvaluator method}}

\begin{fulllineitems}
\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{api:scheduler.FitnessEvaluator.evaluate}}
\pysigstartsignatures
\pysiglinewithargsret
{\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{evaluate}}}
{\sphinxparam{\DUrole{n}{self}\DUrole{p}{:}\DUrole{w}{ }\DUrole{n}{{\hyperref[\detokenize{api:scheduler.FitnessEvaluator}]{\sphinxcrossref{scheduler.FitnessEvaluator}}}}}\sphinxparamcomma \sphinxparam{\DUrole{n}{population}\DUrole{p}{:}\DUrole{w}{ }\DUrole{n}{{\hyperref[\detokenize{api:scheduler.Population}]{\sphinxcrossref{scheduler.Population}}}}}\sphinxparamcomma \sphinxparam{\DUrole{n}{snap}\DUrole{p}{:}\DUrole{w}{ }\DUrole{n}{{\hyperref[\detokenize{api:scheduler.SimulationSnapshot}]{\sphinxcrossref{scheduler.SimulationSnapshot}}}}}}
{{ $\rightarrow$ None}}
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Score every individual in \sphinxstyleemphasis{population} and write the result into each
individual’s \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{fitness}} field.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This is the only method the main GP loop needs to call each generation.
\begin{quote}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Parameters}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{population}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{list}}\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{{[}}}{\hyperref[\detokenize{api:scheduler.Individual}]{\sphinxcrossref{\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{Individual}}}}}\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{{]}}}) \textendash{} The current GP population, obtained via {\hyperref[\detokenize{api:scheduler.SchedulerGP.getPopulation}]{\sphinxcrossref{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{SchedulerGP.getPopulation()}}}}}.
Each individual’s \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{fitness}} field is updated in place.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{snap}} ({\hyperref[\detokenize{api:scheduler.SimulationSnapshot}]{\sphinxcrossref{\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{SimulationSnapshot}}}}}) \textendash{} Read\sphinxhyphen{}only snapshot of the current simulation state.  The evaluator
runs a fresh greedy simulation for every individual, so \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{snap}} is
never modified.

\end{itemize}

\end{description}\end{quote}
\subsubsection*{Notes}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Fitness values are population\sphinxhyphen{}relative: the same tree may receive a
different score in a different generation if the rest of the population
has changed.

\end{fulllineitems}

\index{SimulationSnapshot (class in scheduler)@\spxentry{SimulationSnapshot}\spxextra{class in scheduler}}

\begin{fulllineitems}
\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{api:scheduler.SimulationSnapshot}}
\pysigstartsignatures
\pysigline
{\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{\DUrole{k}{class}\DUrole{w}{ }}}\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{scheduler.}}\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{SimulationSnapshot}}}
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Bases: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pybind11\_object}}

\sphinxAtStartPar
A self\sphinxhyphen{}contained, point\sphinxhyphen{}in\sphinxhyphen{}time snapshot of the simulation world.

\sphinxAtStartPar
The external application must construct and populate a snapshot before
calling {\hyperref[\detokenize{api:scheduler.FitnessEvaluator.evaluate}]{\sphinxcrossref{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{FitnessEvaluator.evaluate()}}}}} for each GP generation.
All satellite and job objects are copied into the snapshot, so subsequent
changes to the originals have no effect on the evaluator.
\subsubsection*{Example}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{snap} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{scheduler}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{SimulationSnapshot}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{currentMinute} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.0}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{satellites}    \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{my\PYGZus{}satellites}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{jobs}          \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{my\PYGZus{}jobs}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{uniformEnergy} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{l+m+mf}{2.5}\PYG{p}{,}   \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} watts per minute per satellite}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\index{buildTerminalRegistry() (in module scheduler)@\spxentry{buildTerminalRegistry()}\spxextra{in module scheduler}}

\begin{fulllineitems}
\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{api:scheduler.buildTerminalRegistry}}
\pysigstartsignatures
\pysiglinewithargsret
{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{scheduler.}}\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{buildTerminalRegistry}}}
{}
{{ $\rightarrow$ list\DUrole{p}{{[}}{\hyperref[\detokenize{api:scheduler.TerminalDef}]{\sphinxcrossref{scheduler.TerminalDef}}}\DUrole{p}{{]}}}}
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Build and return the terminal registry used by the GP algorithm.

\sphinxAtStartPar
The registry maps human\sphinxhyphen{}readable names to field accessors that the expression
tree evaluator uses to read job and satellite features at runtime.  You must
pass the returned list to {\hyperref[\detokenize{api:scheduler.FitnessEvaluator}]{\sphinxcrossref{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{FitnessEvaluator}}}}} and, if you construct
a \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{TreeBuilder}} directly, to that as well.
\begin{quote}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Returns}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Ordered list of terminal definitions.  The index of each entry corresponds
to the \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{terminalIndex}} stored in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{TERMINAL}} nodes of the expression tree.

\sphinxlineitem{Return type}
\sphinxAtStartPar
list{[}{\hyperref[\detokenize{api:scheduler.TerminalDef}]{\sphinxcrossref{TerminalDef}}}{]}

\end{description}\end{quote}
\subsubsection*{Example}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{scheduler} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{buildTerminalRegistry}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{FitnessEvaluator}

\PYG{n}{registry} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{buildTerminalRegistry}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{evaluator} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{FitnessEvaluator}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{registry}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\end{fulllineitems}
